newsitem.title: UK: Car Group to float on London Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Car Group to float on London Stock Exchange.

text.p: The Car Group Plc, a used car retailer, said on Thursday it planned to float on the London Stock Exchange by means of a placing of new shares.
The group, which specialises in used cars less than two years old, trades under the name Car Supermarkets and operates from the West Midlands.
In the year ended August 31, 1996 Car Group sold 19,491 cars and generated operating profits of 5.3 million stg on a turnover of 138.0 million stg.
The sponsor to the issue is NatWest Markets Corporate Finance and the broker is Charterhouse Tilney Securities.
